newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber down, sale to Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber down, sale to Turkey.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were down at midday after a quiet early session, with the only business reported being a consignment of SMR20 to Turkey.

At noon, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted July RSS1 buyer at 280.50 Malaysian cents ($1.12) a kg, down 1.50 cents from Tuesday's close. July SMR20 buyer was priced half cent lower at 256.50.

An official trade source said a "small quantity" of SMR20 was traded to Turkey at 260 cents a kg for July shipment. Traders contacted by Reuters doubted that the deal could have been done on Wednesday.
"It may have been an earlier sale as today's official (SMR20) price is 256.50," said one trader. "I don't see how buyers could be convinced to pay so much higher."
A check with trading houses at noon showed the SMR 20 offered at 255 cents, SMR 10 at 259, SMR 5 at 268, SMR CV at 325, SMR L at 304, and drum latex at 220.
A Malaysian-based shipping agent quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $800 per TEU and $1,700 per two-TEU containers.
